channel.title: Cross-Chain Daily: Bitcoin, DeFi & Crypto Swaps by Chainflip
channel.description: Your daily dose of cross-chain crypto, explained like a conversation and not a lecture. Two hosts and a rotating crew of regulars break down native Bitcoin swaps, BTC-backed lending, DeFi yield, stablecoins, Solana, Ethereum and everything moving between chains. Every episode is based on an article from the Chainflip blog, linked in the show notes. Hosts and guests are fictional characters, voiced with AI clones of real voices used with permission. Nothing here is financial advice.
